last_assistant_message:
All files are in place and valid. Build complete.

## Summary

Built a shared PowerBI-automation skill collection for Rigby, replacing copy-pasted Chrome/Playwright-MCP DOM logic across 5 existing Chase report skills.

**New shared skills** (all single-file, agent-agnostic utility skills — `owning_agent: rigby`, no `.claude/skills/` stub, matching the `git`/`one-password` pattern — fully caller-parameterized per an `## Inputs` table in each):

- `skills/powerbi-navigate-slicer/SKILL.md` — opens a report URL and drives its slicer via one of three DOM patterns (`text-click`, `checkbox-flat`, `dropdown-nested`), parameterized by `report_url`, `connector` (chrome|playwright), `select`/`deselect` labels, and wait timings.
- `skills/powerbi-extract-kpis/SKILL.md` — reads KPI tiles/tables off the current page (`raw`, `regex`, or `tile-scan` modes).
- `skills/vault-freshness-check/SKILL.md` — generic Obsidian cache-freshness gate (vault file, heading pattern, threshold days, extra staleness rule).
- `skills/eval-signal-write/SKILL.md` — generic `systems/eval-harness/skill-runs/{skill}-latest.json` writer.

**Rewrote the 5 existing skills' content files** (`skills/{name}/SKILL.md`) to call into the shared collection. Frontmatter, trigger keywords, descriptions, and output formats were left untouched, so `agents/chase.md`, the `rock1-revenue-monthly`/`rock4-pipeline-weekly`/`one-texas-scorecard` workflows, and the eval-harness assertion files (which all reference these 5 skills by path or trigger phrase) don't need any changes. The `.claude/skills/{name}/SKILL.md` stubs were left alone — they already just dispatch to the content files.

Two mechanics were deliberately **not** forced into the shared KPI-extraction skill: `new-clients`' chart-tooltip-hover read and `revenue-tracker`'s SVG-bar-color-plus-tooltip-hover read. Both use synthetic mouse-event dispatch and DOM/SVG inspection that's materially different from a plain innerText/regex read, so that logic stays inline in those two skills (documented as an intentional scope exception in each).

Also updated `skills/_manifest.jsonl`, `skills/_manifest-rigby.jsonl`, and `skills/_index.md` for the 4 new skills, and appended the work to `evolutions/.pending-changes.json` as `work-20260831-211652`.

**Deferred:** eval authoring/execution and description-tuning (rigby-capability-build steps 6–9) — that's a multi-hour paired-executor/grading/iteration process requiring your sign-off on invocation prompts first. Recommend running it before packaging this evolution; flagged as a note in the pending-changes entry.
